Behind the Buy: The True Cost of a Supplier ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE

The price is only the start.

Why the lowest supplier quote isn't always the lowest cost.

Choose a scenario to watch. Each one compares three quotations for the same requirement.

What this training covers

Comparing supplier quotations means comparing the same thing. Four short, narrated scenarios show how: costs a quote left out, a cost nobody priced yet, an exception to a required contract clause, and a case where the lowest quote really does hold up.

Illustrative only: examples, not benchmarks. Actual requirements depend on the contracts, regulations and company procedures.
